<h2>Load Trait Corrections</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Loads a trait-corrections CSV file without applying or approving
its instructions.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_trait_corrections(path_trait_corrections)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="path_trait_corrections">path_trait_corrections</code></td>
<td>
<p>A single character string giving the path to a trait-corrections
CSV file.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble containing the correction instructions stored in
'path_trait_corrections'.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[validate_trait_corrections()], [correct_trait_records()],
[write_trait_quality_control_report()]
</p>

</main>
